M-Au Thank you for calling Forest Apartments. Press one to speak to our on-site manager.
All residents should be aware that next week we will start updating the laundry facilities in each of our buildings.

The Maple building will be first.

So it's time we try something similar—but, of course, even better. Our discount offer is ten percent, while theirs is only five percent. Please spend some time looking over the four rules of use at the bottom.
We may need to revisit the one about using multiple discounts.
Our customers do love manufacturer coupons. We will monitor customer complaints.
